label: foundations-apply
tail:
A4 is complete for wave 4 foundations; independent A6 certification remains pending.

- Classified and retagged all 34 items: 4 literature-derived, 26 AI-altered, 4 AI-generated.
- Applied all nine A3-approved material repairs and removed their stale certifications.
- Corrected source evidence, including [Tarski’s original 1924 article](https://pldml.icm.edu.pl/pldml/element/bwmeta1.element.bwnjournal-article-fmv5i1p18bwm) and the exact family-form König theorem in the [Colorado handout](https://math.colorado.edu/~kearnes/Teaching/Courses/F25/cardinals_arithmetic.pdf).
- Read all 171 numbered steps and 407 direct citations; no coverage exception.
- Proof contracts pass 29/29; precheck passes all nine repaired items; content-policy passes 34/34.
- All other gates pass. `depcheck` reports only the expected nine `published-unaudited` items awaiting A6.
- Touchlog reports no item repaired more than once.

Artifacts: [findings](/root/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/audit/wave4-foundations.findings.md), [provenance ledger](/root/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/audit/wave4-foundations.provenance.jsonl), and [proof contracts](/root/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/audit/wave4-foundations.proof-contracts.json).
